findings.requirement: REQ-120 (description, the rehearsal job: «database A migrated to the previous schema (every migration file but the newest)»)
findings.problem: grants.sql holds the grants of every table, including those of the newest migration, and a failing grants file is exit 1 (MG-6). If the job builds A with migrate.js over the migrations without the newest file, the grants step fails on the missing tables and the rehearsal is red for a reason that is not a defect. The text does not say how A is built or that grants.sql must apply on any prefix of the migrations.
findings.needed: Name one of: A is built without the grants step (A only feeds the dump, which carries no ACL), or grants.sql is written so it applies to whichever tables exist; the code design can pick, but the block should name the constraint.
